description:
Make a redo record refuse a put or delete at the event log, so the log changes only by its positioned append, and delete the publish check's handling of either.

## Background

Repository deltas reject any non-append action on the event log (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/image.rs`), but `RedoRecord::new` (`storage/redo_record.rs`) checks only path overlap, so a record could put or delete the log. The publish check in `storage/repository_state_store.rs` treats a put or delete at the log as touching it. The rustdoc of `RedoRecord`'s event append states where the append lands as "the log's length"; appends land at the log's committed length, the end of its last newline-terminated line.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `RedoRecord::new` returns an error for a put or delete at the event log, and one test owns the refusal.
- [hard] REQ-02: The publish check decides whether a record touches the event log from its event append alone, and no code path handles a put or delete at the log.
- [hard] REQ-03: The rustdoc of the record's event append says committed length.
title: Redo records refuse a rewrite of the event log
